method: r2 -e asm.bits=16 -qc 'aaa; aflj' AppleARM7M.kext.bin, union of [addr, addr+size) ranges (half-open) to avoid double-counting overlaps
note: r2's own automatic function detection (aa/aaa) badly undercounts this binary -- it missed start(), startCPU(), and the 0x80713510 method entirely, all three found tonight by hand (string/xref tracing, not aflj). 'Auto-recognized' is a tool-coverage floor, not a measure of what has actually been examined; see the per-function fiches in this directory for what a human actually read. None of the five ranges above overlap any reviewed_ranges in this directory's own fiches -- the two counts are genuinely disjoint for this binary, not just differently labelled.
